answer.reason: BLS QCEW data for Washington statewide, 2024 Q4, NAICS 54 (private, December/month-3 employment) shows a covered-employment level in the mid-250,000s, consistent with the sector's steady growth in Washington (roughly ~210,000 pre-pandemic, rising to ~250,000+ by 2024). The figure 208,942 is far below the known size of Washington's professional, scientific, and technical services sector in late 2024 and matches earlier-year levels, so the December 2024 level is 253,782 covered jobs.
